DECK: Discipleship Experience (Section 11) Believers' Authority/Charisma

Q1. "Not everything which is physical in its manifestation is physical in its source." What is the main point of this statement?
A. Spiritual problems never show up physically
B. Only physical problems are real
C. Something can show up physically while its root cause is spiritual
D. Physical problems should never be treated by doctors alone
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: While a problem may have a physical manifestation, its underlying root cause can often be spiritual.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [08:42], [14:27]

Q2. In Mark 5, which two effects of the demon on the man are mentioned in the teaching?
A. He lived in a graveyard and had supernatural strength
B. He lived in a mountain and could not sleep
C. He was bent over and had supernatural strength
D. He could not speak and lived in a graveyard
ANSWER: A
EXPLANATION: The man in Mark 5 lived in a graveyard and possessed supernatural strength capable of breaking chains.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [15:37] - [16:38]

Q3. Which account correctly reflects the sequence that led to Saul's tormented state?
A. He grew envious of David, the Spirit of God left him, then he disobeyed and wanted to kill David
B. An evil spirit entered him and this caused the Spirit of God to leave him
C. He disobeyed, and an evil spirit entered him while the Spirit of God remained upon him
D. He disobeyed, the Spirit of God left him, and an evil spirit then entered him
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: Saul's disobedience caused the Spirit of God to leave him, allowing an evil spirit to enter.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS II – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [00:16]

Q4. A believer says, "Anger is just anger, it is only human nature." Which response aligns with the teaching?
A. Ordinary envy becomes demonic once it is acted upon publicly
B. Demon spirits can only exploit envy in people who are not believers
C. Envy is always demonic in origin
D. Some anger is ordinary, but where an inroad exists, demon spirits can take advantage of it
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: While natural anger exists, holding onto it creates an inroad that demon spirits can exploit.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [05:22] - [06:35]

Q5. Which statement about believers and demon spirits is true?
A. Meeting a demon spirit is a sign that the Spirit of God has left the believer
B. Believers can avoid demon spirits entirely if they understand the devil's tricks
C. Believers only meet demon spirits after giving an inroad through sin or unforgiveness
D. Believers will encounter demon spirits in this world whether they like it or not, so they must be ready to act
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: Believers will inevitably encounter demon spirits in the world and must recognize their operations to act accordingly.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS II – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [07:09] - [08:06]

Q6. Which statement is consistent with what was taught about pride, humility and honour?
A. Honour people in your own way, since the realm of the spirit ignores social context
B. Stop honouring people, since the realm of the spirit differs from our culture
C. Find a way to honour people in a way their social context perceives honour, while remembering the realm of the spirit differs from our culture
D. Let our social ideas of humility decide how we speak about God's power in warfare
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: We should honor people according to their social context, while keeping in mind that spiritual laws regarding pride and humility differ from cultural norms.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS III – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [05:45] - [06:36], [09:57]

Q7. Which best describes a believer's relationship with boasting?
A. They may boast in Christ, but only in warfare
B. They boast in Christ and not in their own efforts
C. Boasting has no place in their life, since salvation is by grace alone
D. They may boast in their own efforts, provided they give Christ credit afterwards
ANSWER: B
EXPLANATION: Believers are called to boast, but their boasting should be centered in Christ Jesus rather than their own fleshly efforts.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS III – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [03:49]

Q8. A beginner has made bold declarations, stepped in and worshipped, yet the demons have not left. What's the next step to take?
A. Keep repeating the declarations until the demons leave, since glory touch is for experienced ministers
B. Go to glory touch privately, so the person is not embarrassed in front of others
C. Go to glory touch with people around, because demons only leave when a group is present
D. Go to glory touch with people around, because those being delivered can become violent
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: If earlier steps fail, a beginner should proceed to the glory touch with others present, as the person being delivered may become physically violent.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS IV – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [05:16]

Q9. What point is made through Jesus feeling the touch of the woman with the issue of blood?
A. Jesus released power only after deciding to, so glory is never transferred unknowingly
B. The woman's faith, not the glory in Jesus, produced the transfer of power
C. Jesus felt the touch, showing a believer can be conscious of the glory of God within them
D. Christ entered the Most Holy Place every year with His own blood, while the Old Testament high priest offered animal blood only once for Israel.
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: Jesus feeling the touch demonstrates that believers can be consciously aware of the glory of God flowing through them.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS IV – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [07:36] - [08:29]

Q10. A believer perceives a demon in a colleague who is awake and alert. Which approach is appropriate?
A. Ask or offer to pray for them, without telling them directly or rudely that they have a demon
B. Tell them plainly that they have a demon so they can consent to prayer
C. Wait until they are asleep, then cast the demon out without ever telling them
D. Say nothing and pray privately, since offering prayer risks offence
ANSWER: A
EXPLANATION: Rather than bluntly telling someone they have a demon, which might cause offense, it is better to politely offer to pray for them.
REF: HOW TO CAST OUT DEMONS IV – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [13:46] - [14:32]

Q11. God moves in a person's life through two streams. Which pair names them?
A. The word and the anointing
B. Faith and glory
C. Faith and the anointing
D. Faith and worship
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: God operates in a believer's life through the dual streams of faith and the anointing.
REF: MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [00:15] - [01:02]

Q12. Which option best describes how the two streams relate?
A. Symbiotic: each supports the other, and walking consistently in glory means learning how they work together
B. Sequential: One opens the way, and the other takes over afterwards
C. Competing: a believer should choose the stronger stream and stay in it
D. Independent: one meets some needs and the other meets others
ANSWER: A
EXPLANATION: Faith and the anointing have a symbiotic relationship; walking consistently in God's power requires understanding how to partner with both.
REF: MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [01:02] - [01:52]

Q13. Which sequence describes what the stream of faith requires of a believer?
A. Believe, know, practise
B. Know, practise, believe
C. Know, believe, teach
D. Know, believe, practise
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: The stream of faith requires a believer to first know the Word, then believe it, and finally practice it.
REF: MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [02:43]

Q14. A believer handles scripture casually but expects it to transform their life. Which statement applies to them?
A. The word transforms anyone who hears it, whatever their disposition
B. The word has sacred impact on the lives of those who hold sacred reverence for it
C. The word transforms those who know it thoroughly
D. The word transforms only those who first receive the anointing
ANSWER: B
EXPLANATION: The Word of God delivers its powerful impact to those who treat it with sacred reverence, rather than casual familiarity.
REF: MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [02:43] - [03:31]

Q15. A believer declares in general terms that "God's word works" over a problem but sees no change. What is missing?
A. Greater intensity in declaring the word, since volume releases faith
B. Agreement with others, since faith can be released corporately
C. Because the Bible is the standard for Christian belief, so questioning its origin and validity raises a question about the foundation of the faith.
D. Because the Bible must be confirmed by archaeological discoveries before Christians can accept its teachings.
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: The Bible sets the standard for everything believers hold to be true, meaning any question regarding its origin and validity directly questions the foundation of the Christian faith.
REF: IS THE BIBLE TRUE. I – Celebration Church International - LMS_2.mp4 — [00:29] - [01:14]

Q16. A believer says, "I know the word and I believe it, so I have done everything faith requires." What is missing?
A. Practising the word, since knowing and believing are only two of the three requirements
B. Nothing, since knowing and believing are what faith requires
C. Teaching the word to others, as faith is completed by teaching
D. The anointing, since the stream of faith ends once the word is believed
ANSWER: A
EXPLANATION: Knowing and believing are insufficient on their own; true faith also requires practicing (doing) the Word.
REF: MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [10:52]; MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD II – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [01:18] - [01:49]

Q17. A believer senses the anointing strongly in a meeting, yet the situation is not changing. Which response fits how the two streams work together?
A. Wait quietly, since the anointing carries out everything by itself
B. Drop faith, since the anointing has taken over
C. Take a step of faith, since the two streams work together and sometimes faith must step forward
D. Suspect the anointing is just goosebumps, since it should have settled the matter
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: Faith and the anointing work symbiotically; when one stream seems insufficient alone, taking a bold step of faith can trigger the manifestation.
REF: MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [01:02] - [01:52]

Q18. Becoming a doer of the word of God indicates which of the following?
A. You have gained enough knowledge of the word of God to do it
B. You have enough reverence for the word of God to do it
C. You have spent enough time building confidence, now you are capable of doing it
D. You have spent enough time watching your pastor do it, now you are confident enough to do it
ANSWER: B
EXPLANATION: Acting on the Word of God is the ultimate proof that a believer holds sacred reverence for it.
REF: MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD II – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [01:53]

Q19. You try to cast out a demon, but nothing dramatic happens, what should your conclusion be?
A. Demons don't exist
B. You need to brush up on your exorcism skills
C. You don't have the requisite anointing for the task
D. The Word, not the evidence, settles the act
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: Faith dictates that the believer's confidence remains in the Word of God, regardless of immediate physical evidence or dramatic manifestations.
REF: MANIFESTING THE PRESENCE OF GOD II – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [02:47] - [03:56]

Q20. When casting out a demon, which of the following best indicates the effectiveness of the anointing?
A. An energy level that zings like electricity at the tip of your fingers
B. Violent shaking, jumping and shouting of the possessed
C. Assurance of effectiveness comes by the Spirit
D. The number of people praying at the same time
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: While physical signs may occur, the primary and most reliable assurance that a demon has been expelled comes through spiritual discernment.

Q21. The symbiotic relationship between faith and the anointing is represented by which of the following?
A. Multiple confirmations of full manifestation
B. A spiritual note of victory
C. Learning to see, even if it's in seed form, what God is doing
D. Treating faith and the anointing as unrelated to one another
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: The partnership between faith and the anointing requires a believer to spiritually perceive and respond to what God is doing, even when it appears only in seed form.

Q22. The Spirit realm operates like a courtroom which consists of the following except
A. A Judge
B. An Accuser
C. An Attorney
D. The Devil
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: The spiritual courtroom is comprised of legal roles including a Judge, an Accuser, and a Defense Attorney; "the devil" is an entity, not the legal title of the role.
REF: POWER IN THE BLOOD I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [02:26] - [09:03]

Q23. The word "Satan" always has an evil personality.
A. True
B. False
C. Partially false
D. True, but with some caveats
ANSWER: B
EXPLANATION: The word "Satan" means "accuser" or "opposer" and was even used to describe an angel of the Lord standing in opposition, devoid of an evil personality.
REF: POWER IN THE BLOOD I – Celebration Church International - LMS.mp4 — [05:43] - [06:36]

Q24. What role does Jesus play in the spirit realm?
A. Propitiation
B. Sanctification
C. Justice
D. Defense Attorney
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: In the spiritual courtroom, Jesus serves as our advocate and defense attorney.

Q25. What was the first recorded death in the bible?
A. Abel
B. Adam and Eve, spiritually
C. A sacrifice
D. The death of Cain
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: The first physical death recorded in the Bible was not Abel's murder, but God sacrificing an animal to cover Adam and Eve.

Q26. What is one fact about spiritual legality that many do not know?
A. They belong to every believer
B. They are ratified by the blood
C. They must be continually defended
D. They depend on a person's personal merit
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: In the realm of spiritual legality, possessing a right does not automatically guarantee its enforcement; believers must actively stand on and defend their rights.

Q27. Leviticus 17:11 best explains which of the following legal principles of the spirit realm?
A. Substitutionary Atonement
B. Propitiation
C. The Principle of Substitution
D. The principle of creation
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: Leviticus 17:11 establishes that the life of the flesh is in the blood, which forms the legal basis for the principle of substitution.

A. Substitution, Ransom, Redemption
B. Substitution, Petition, Revelation

ANSWER: A

Q29. An animal can play your part in a spiritual ritual to the degree that when the animal is offered, it is as if your life is offered. Which principle is this?
A. Legality
B. Ransom
C. Substitution
D. Consecration
ANSWER: C
EXPLANATION: The principle of substitution allows an animal's life to legally take the place of a human's life in a spiritual ritual.

Q30. Which of the following statements best explain the principle of Ransom?
A. The price paid to buy back or release someone that was lost or enslaved
B. The price paid to ratify the release of someone that was held in bondage
C. The price paid to justify the release of someone that was held in bondage
D. The price paid to release someone that was held in bondage
ANSWER: D
EXPLANATION: Ransom legally refers to the precise price paid to secure the release of someone who has been held in bondage.
